|rulings=* Each lightsaber swing is a separate top-level action in the weapons segment (meaning the opponent gets an action between swings, you may take other actions between swings, etc).<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Mace%20Windu%20%28V%29%20%28C-Slip%20AI%202%29 Scomp: Mace Windu (V) (AI)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* The second swing may be at the same target or a different target from the first swing.
* When using [[Sorry About The Mess]] to swing during the control phase, Mace only swings once. If Mace then battles later that turn, he may still swing twice in that battle.
